name: Pearson Edexcel international - iPrimary to International A Level (Year 1 to Year 13)

verification.notes: Draft: no Pearson Edexcel examiner or school reviewer has checked this pack. Source links: all seven URLs resolved to the named pages on 2026-10-21 (titles matched). What is a placeholder, not a claim: every percentage-to-grade band. Pearson sets grade boundaries for each qualification and each exam series after marking, so international_gcse_9_1, international_gcse_a_star_g and international_a_level are school defaults and are declared overridable (grading_scales.<code>.bands); a school must replace them with the board's boundaries for the session. What is structured but unverified: the International GCSE Mathematics A paper structure (two papers of 100 marks, half the qualification each) follows the published specification and was not re-read from the specification PDF in this environment; International AS and A Level subjects declare no papers, because components are scoped to the learning area and cannot carry both an International GCSE and an advanced paper set. No board assessment is declared at Year 6 or Year 9: the iPrimary and iLowerSecondary assessments are optional school assessments, and calling them national assessments would overclaim. UCAS: the A Level tariff is per grade, not per grade and subject: A* 56, A 48, B 40, C 32, D 24, E 16, U 0, summed over the qualifications the candidate takes. The tariff table itself is rendered client-side on the UCAS page and was not read off it, so the figures come from platform spec 03 Appendix C, and no AS or International GCSE tariff is modelled because none could be verified. Grade codes: an asterisk cannot appear in a pack code, so A* is A_STAR with the printed grade as the label. Calendar: one template per pack, so a southern-hemisphere school overrides structure.calendar_template.periods. Locale: English only; other languages are a translation task, not a pack version.
